analyzed_vuln.description: Use-of-uninitialized-value is caused by explicitly destroying fScratchGlyphRun in SkGlyphRunBuilder::initialize() without reconstructing it before later use. The subsequent draw path reuses the dead object via useGlyphRun()/drawGlyphRun, so fRunPaint (including shader sk_sp) is read from a non-live object, yielding uninitialized data observed in SkShaderBase::asLuminanceColor (crash site in skia/src/shaders/SkShader.cpp).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In api_raster_n32_canvas, fuzzed drawText reaches SkCanvas::onDrawText -> SkGlyphRunBuilder::drawText. For non-empty text, initialize() is called and runs fScratchGlyphRun.~SkGlyphRun(); then simplifyDrawText/useGlyphRun proceed and later text rendering computes paint luminance (SkPaint::computeLuminanceColor -> just_a_color -> shader->asLuminanceColor). Because fScratchGlyphRun was destroyed and not placement-new reconstructed, its paint/shader state is invalid/uninitialized, triggering MSan. The provided PoV drives this text draw path and exposes the bug.
